comparison.objective: Close an air circuit breaker manually when its motor operator is unavailable; body and specs are absent.
comparison.physical_skill: Manual mechanism actuation against breaker resistance/interlocks, not bimanual striking and debris recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Breaker reaches the closed state; required actuation sequence and thresholds are unavailable.
comparison.reason: Breaker state transition is a different mechanism and outcome from tang fracture and containment.
